title: Implementation of a New Hampshire community-initiated response to the opioid crisis: A mixed-methods process evaluation of Safe Station

journal: The International journal on drug policy
integrity_detail: No correction/retraction relation found in the current PubMed record; this is not proof of absolute absence.

appraisal_summary: AI-assisted provisional appraisal: mixed-method rationale and integration are reported; quantitative samples are small and significance testing was not performed.
